data.one_liner: AES encrypted wrapper for shared_preferences to securely store sensitive data.
data.what_it_does: Adds an extra layer of AES encryption to key-value data saved via shared_preferences. It supports various data types, stream-based observers for key changes, and a custom encryptor interface.
use_when: You need to store encrypted simple key-value data on device
You want a drop-in replacement or wrapper over shared_preferences with encryption
avoid_when: You need robust, platform-backed secure storage like Keychain or Keystore directly without a custom password key
strengths: Supports multiple data types including strings, numbers, booleans, and lists
Includes stream observers and widgets to react to storage changes
weaknesses: Relies on a user-provided encryption key which must be managed securely
Plain shared_preferences underlying storage can still be accessed if the key is compromised

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: Uses platform-native secure storage mechanisms (Keychain/EncryptedSharedPreferences) natively instead of manual AES wrappers over plain shared preferences.
